column1: # Rule: a mask group with its own blending (a paint effect in a mask). Its actions composite on their own into one
# grey layer, straight value v at coverage a; that layer then blends with the mask below:
# result = b + (clamp(f(b, v)) - b) w a, f the group's mode (by stored blend id), w its opacity.
# Source: measurement "Mask groups measured" (every mode: mean 0.001, max 0.01 of a step, 100% within 1). Ids here are
# the modes seen in real projects (Normal, Multiply, Linear dodge, Overlay, Subtract).
# Columns: below = b; group_value = v; group_coverage = a; opacity = w; expected = result.
